messages:
anna_devex: Heads-up — I want to propose landing a new routing header (v2) to unify weighted-routing + affinity + policy hints into a single header. Goal: simpler SDK surface, fewer header races, and explicit versioning.

sam_platform: quick q — is this a breaking change for existing SDKs or opt-in? :eyes:

anna_devex: opt-in initially. SDKs would set x-redwood-routing when users explicitly enable advanced routing or when console enables the new runtime flag. Server will still accept old headers.

mike_eng: can we avoid parsing JSON blobs in the proxy for perf? any thoughts on a compact encoding?

lisa_console: from console side we'll need telemetry to show rollout % and failure modes. we should tag traces with route_policy_version and route_decision to help surface regressions in dashboards. also need a toggle per-customer.

anna_devex: agree on telemetry. proposal: header format is compact base64 of a small protobuf (fields: version, policy, weight, affinity_id, fallback). server does lightweight decode; proxy can route without full parse using prefix bytes.

sam_platform: ok. what about SDK ergonomics — want examples for py/ts so we can ship preview in next SDK patch. also need migration docs.

anna_devex: here's a quick usage sketch — keep it minimal so we don't ship big surface changes:

Python:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
client.generate("Write me a summary", routing={"policy":"cost_aware","weight":0.2, "affinity":"user-123"})
```

TypeScript:
```ts
import { Redwood } from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood()
client.generate('Summarize this', { routing: { policy: 'cost_aware', weight: 0.2, affinity: 'user-123' } })
```

anna_devex: SDKs would translate that into x-redwood-routing header only when routing is provided; default behavior unchanged.

mike_eng: server fallback plan: if we see old-header present, ignore v2; if both present, prefer v2. We can also implement a compatibility shim that consumes v1 and emits v2 internally for a short window.

lisa_console: rollout idea: console flag per-organization. pilot with internal orgs + 3 customers, canary 10% global traffic -> 50% -> 100% over 3 weeks. dashboards: route_policy_version, p75 latency by version, error-rate by version, and map to customer toggle.

sam_platform: what's the deprecation window for v1 header? customers need time.

anna_devex: propose: v1 supported for 6 months after v2 GA, with recorded telemetry on v1 usage and warnings surfaced in console as customers use deprecated header. also CLI linter in SDKs to warn at dev time.

mike_eng: tests we need: interop test matrix across go/py/ts SDKs, end-to-end routing determinism tests, functionality when affinity IDs are long, and fuzzing for header decode.

anna_devex: creating RFC + rollout checklist: https://redwood.internal/rfc/1287 (draft). please add test cases.

lisa_console: one more: add a small console UX for route-preview that shows the evaluated policy for a sample request (like a dry-run). helps debug.

sam_platform: +1. also let's ensure telemetry sampling doesn't hide regressions — start at 100% event capture for first week of pilot, then lower to 10% after stable.

deploy-bot: deploy started: api-proxy:v3-route-header-experiment -> env=staging (build 8342)

deploy-bot: deploy success: api-proxy:v3-route-header-experiment -> staging (5m 12s)

mike_eng: I'll wire up the compatibility shim in proxy and add decode perf benchmarks. aiming for <200ns per-request extra cost.

anna_devex: thanks all — action items:
- mike: proxy shim + perf bench (ticket #RT-412)
- sam: SDK preview patches + linter warning (ticket #SDK-201)
- lisa: console toggle + telemetry dashboards (ticket #CON-88)
- anna: update RFC and rollout checklist (RFC-1287)

sam_platform: sounds good, will put SDK PRs in draft by EOD and call out breaking notes if any. :thumbsup:

anna_devex: we'll huddle briefly tomorrow 10:30 to triage blockers before starting canary.

lisa_console: I'm in.

mike_eng: me too.

sam_platform: thanks — will add chairs/attendees to calendar.

anna_devex: closing thread for now, will reopen with pilot metrics. :rock_on:
